Name: Ephron
Summary: Ephron was a Hittite landowner who sold Abraham the cave of Machpelah as a burial place for Sarah.
KeyStory: Ephron offered the field freely, but Abraham insisted on paying the full price — four hundred shekels of silver — so the burial ground would be indisputably his.
RelatedPeople: Abraham; Sarah; Zohar, Father of Ephron
LifeLesson: Honest dealing matters: Abraham paid full price rather than accept a gift that could be disputed.
